note:
rowOrder = "contextBottomLeftOrigin": read straight out of CGContext.data, never through a CGImage, so rows are in Core Graphics' bottom-left origin order, not an image file's top-left origin.
Each record holds side*side*4 = 4096 bytes, RGBA8 premultiplied, sRGB.
path = "coreImage" (11 modes) can never match a hand-written W3C formula: the implementation is closed-source CoreImage.
path = "coreGraphics" (13 modes) is closed-source CoreGraphics, so whether it matches W3C cannot be decided from the source - these pixels are what makes that difference measurable.
